Lump the Enlightened lurks in the ruined remains of Blighted Village with two ogre companions during Act One. Despite being an ogre, Lump has unusually high intelligence.
“
I've no use for the Absolute - or any god. I follow two masters only: gluttony and greed.
„
— Lump, speaking the party

Involvement

Act One

Lump is in the Blighted Village with  Chock and  Fank. If the party approach Lump, he asks to see their Brand of the Absolute. If the brand has not been received, Lump attacks unless he is convinced otherwise:

  • [BRANDED] Show him your brand.
  • [DECEPTION] I'll do you one better - I'm one of the Absolute's chosen disciples. (DC 10)
    • (Upon failure) Lump: I expect more than your word. Show me your flesh.
      • [DECEPTION] Flash your arm at him. There you are. You could see the brand, could you not? (DC 10)
      • [INTIMIDATION] Do not test the Absolute's finest, ogre. You would not survive Her wrath. (DC 10)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] What about you? I'm feeling hungry... (DC 10)
  • [BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION] ROAR. (DC 10 )
  • [PALADIN] [INTIMIDATION] Try to eat me and I'll brand your corpse with the mark of my oath. (DC 10)

Lump can be convinced to work for the party instead of the Absolute:

  • I'll give you 500 gold if I can call you into battle.
  • [DECEPTION] I'll give you 1000 gold - after you fight for me. (DC 10)[2]
  • I'll give you 1000 gold - after you fight for me.[3]
  • [ROGUE] [DECEPTION] 1000 gold - to be paid once the killing's done. (DC 5)[2]
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] How about I spare your life. That tempting enough? (DC 20)
  • [BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION] JOIN ME OR I'LL CRUSH YOU TO PULP! (DC 20 )
  • [PERSUASION] I'll pay you in the flesh of the fallen - you'll have your fill. (DC 15)[3]
  • [PERSUASION] I'll pay you in the flesh of the fallen - you'll have your fill. (DC 20)[2]
  • [PALADIN] [INTIMIDATION] Fight for me and my oath or I'll cut the last meal from your belly. (DC 20)

If Lump agrees to work for the party, he offers  Lump's War Horn, which can be used three times to summon Lump and his two ogre companions. He and his ogre companions leave Blighted Village and can be called upon if the party do not stray too far. For example, the horn cannot be used in the Shadow-Cursed Lands. If the party pickpock the horn from him, blowing it leads to combat with the ogres, as Lump correctly deduces the horn was stolen from him.

If promised gold, Lump collects it after the first fight, at which point he can be paid, attacked, or convinced to wait for a 2500 gold payment after the next fight with a  DC 15 Deception Check.

If Lump was promised gold but never called, he eventually appears in camp to collect, and the party can pay him or intimidate him into leaving:

  • Pay him what you promised.
  • [INTIMIDATION] We have a new bargain: I pay nothing, and you leave the camp alive. (DC 20)
  • [BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION] FOLLOW ME AGAIN AND I'LL EAT YOU. (DC 20 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] You can leave alive, or you can roast over my campfire. (DC 20 )

Any other option causes the ogres to attack.

Lump accidentally ate a  Warped Headband of Intellect, which, even though not worn, is the source of his unusually high Intelligence for an Ogre.[4]

The following inspiration can be gained:

  • ⁠Bodyguards for Hire ( Noble backgrounds) - for recruiting the ogres
  • ⁠Creatures of Bloodlust ( Haunted One backgrounds) - promising to pay with the corpses of slain enemies
  • ⁠Pyramid Scheme ( Urchin backgrounds) - convincing to work without offering gold

Companion approval

  • Hire Lump and his ogres.  +1  +1

Tactics

Lump is vulnerable to many spells due to his low  Wisdom. His AC is also quite low, despite being higher than most ogres. Bursting him with powerful spells and strong melee attacks like  Divine Smite prevents him from unleashing too much damage.  Smokepowder is also effective against him.

If the party is a sufficient distance away, Lump casts  Blur which will make him more difficult to hit. Breaking his Concentration can be difficult due to his high  Constitution. He also throws Acid Arrow to create  Acid surfaces. Similar to other ogres, Lump excels at melee combat and is capable of dealing significant damage. He also exploits the party's use of  Grease with  Fire Bolt, lighting the area on fire.

Notes and references

  1. ↑ In addition to his increased  Intelligence, Lump the Enlightened has slightly more HP than is typical for an Ogre. His slightly better armour also causes him to have an Armour Class 1 higher than normal for an Ogre.
